# `csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks`

Allow a block the author wrote on one line to stay on one line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int X { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    public void Empty() { }
}
```

### `csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks = true`

```ini
csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks = true
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks = false`

```ini
csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks = false
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int X
    {
        get; set;
    }
    public string Name
    {
        get; set;
    } = "";
    public void Empty()
    {
    }
}
```
